Epic is rolling generative AI voices into Fortnite, and some of its own characters already sound like cheap imitations. As UEFN and Unreal Engine converge, this is no longer just a strange Fortnite feature. It is an early look at how Epic wants future games to be made, even if human performance and the quality bar are what get left behind.
